title: Gravitas verdict
description: One refuter's or lens verifier's verdict on one finding. Maps onto scripts/ledger.py verdict.

status.description: done when the verdict is complete; blocked when a path in the prompt was relative, something needed was missing, or a tool was denied.

key.description: The ledger key of the finding judged.

refuted.description: yes if the claim is false or unsupported, no if it survived a real attempt to refute it, blocked if a tool was denied or the evidence was unreachable. Default to yes when uncertain.

lens.description: The lens applied, e.g. correctness, security, performance, reproduces.

tier.description: The tier of the evidence behind the verdict.

source.description: What produced that tier, in the same form as a finding's source.

reason.description: The evidence for the verdict in one to three sentences.

error.description: What is missing, or the exact error text, when status or refuted is blocked. Empty otherwise.
